campaigns.name: KAPIME
campaigns.subtitle: Hepatitis Awareness & Prevention
campaigns.description: Kapime means 'Get Tested' in Swahili. This flagship initiative raises awareness about Hepatitis B, encourages vaccination, and connects communities to testing and care.
campaigns.whatIs: A community-driven hepatitis awareness campaign focused on education, early screening promotion, and preventive health practices.
campaigns.whyMatters: Viral hepatitis is a silent epidemic in Tanzania, with thousands unaware of their infection status. Without early detection and treatment, it can lead to liver cancer and cirrhosis.
howWorks: Community awareness sessions via radio and public forums
Health marathons to engage the public on hepatitis prevention
School and university hepatitis education outreaches
Encouraging early testing and preventive practices
activities2025: World Hepatitis Day media engagement (radio broadcast)
Community health marathon for hepatitis awareness
Hepatitis education outreach in schools & universities
impact2025: 500+ individuals reached at World Hepatitis Day

testimonial.quote: The KAPIME campaign opened my eyes to hepatitis — I never knew how serious and preventable it was until I attended the marathon.
testimonial.name: Community Participant
testimonial.role: World Hepatitis Day, Dar es Salaam 2025

campaigns.name: Life Unlocked
campaigns.subtitle: Mental Health for Youth Transitions
campaigns.description: Supporting young Tanzanians through mental health awareness, resilience-building, and peer support — especially during the challenging transitions from school to life.
campaigns.whatIs: A youth-focused mental health initiative delivering awareness sessions in schools and universities to reduce stigma and build resilience.
campaigns.whyMatters: Mental health challenges are growing among young Tanzanians, yet stigma and limited resources prevent most from seeking help. Early education is key to changing this.
howWorks: Mental health awareness workshops in secondary schools
University outreach sessions on stress, anxiety and wellbeing
Connecting youth to available mental health resources
whereActive: City College (Main Campus), Dar es Salaam
Temeke Secondary School, Dar es Salaam
activities2025: Mental health awareness sessions at City College (main campus)
Mental health outreach at Temeke Secondary School
impact2025: Increased youth awareness on mental health
Improved mental health understanding among students

testimonial.quote: This session made me realize mental health is just as important as physical health. I finally felt comfortable talking about what I was going through.
testimonial.name: Student Participant

campaigns.name: Talk To Heal
campaigns.subtitle: Mental Health Conversations & Support
campaigns.description: Creating safe, open spaces for health conversations in communities — covering mental health, HIV testing awareness, and hepatitis prevention through community engagement events.
campaigns.whatIs: A community engagement program bringing health awareness and open conversations directly to communities through organized events.
campaigns.whyMatters: Many Tanzanians lack access to accurate health information in their communities. Stigma around HIV and mental health prevents early help-seeking. Community conversations break these barriers.
howWorks: Facilitating open discussions on mental health in communities
Educating communities on HIV and hepatitis testing
Empowering community members with preventive health knowledge
activities2025: 2 community engagement events on mental health
Mental health awareness programs for communities
impact2025: Improved understanding of HIV & hepatitis testing
Enhanced mental health awareness and community participation

testimonial.quote: For the first time our community had an open conversation about mental health. People who never spoke up before started sharing their experiences.
testimonial.name: Community Member

campaigns.ctaText: Bring Talk To Heal to Your Community
